channel.title: AI Threat Watch: AR
channel.description: Verified case files located in AR.

item.title: [LOW] AI-altered video of Argentine spokesman Adorni touts fake YPF investment platform
item.description: Chequeado rated false a Facebook video in which a July 2025 press conference by spokesman Manuel Adorni was altered with AI to announce a YPF platform paying 3 million pesos a month; links led to phishing sites. Target: Argentine Facebook users; YPF and spokesman Manuel Adorni. AR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Argentine federal prosecutor probes AI video of minister Caputo promoting Immediate AI
item.description: Authorities warned of a fake AI video of Economy Minister Luis Caputo endorsing the Immediate AI Comerciante platform, promising daily gains of up to 2M pesos; Fiscalia Federal No 5 under Franco Picardi took the case. Target: Argentine social media users. AR. Verification: confirmed.
